name: washpro
description: WashPro — Doorstep car washing & detailing platform (Hyderabad)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @washpro/shared-types && npm run build -w @zylo/field && npm run build -w @washpro/admin-dashboard
scripts.build:unified: npm run build -w @washpro/shared-types && npm run build -w @zylo/website && ZYLO_BASE=/field/ npm run build -w @zylo/field && ZYLO_BASE=/admin/ npm run build -w @washpro/admin-dashboard && node scripts/assemble-unified-hosting.mjs
scripts.typecheck:unified: npm run typecheck -w @zylo/website && npm run typecheck -w @zylo/field && npm run typecheck -w @washpro/admin-dashboard
scripts.test: npm run test -w @washpro/shared-types && npm run test -w @zylo/field
scripts.deploy:main:staging-channel: npm run build:unified && firebase hosting:channel:deploy unified-preview --only main
scripts.deploy:main: npm run build:unified && firebase deploy --only hosting:main
